label: Hairstyle
description: Named haircuts, braids, twists, locs, updos, ponytails, bangs, set curls and period hairstyles.
notes: Named cuts and arrangements belong here, phrased as noun phrases after in; person.hair_length owns loose length, person.hair_texture owns curl pattern and density, and person.hair_color owns color. Short means above the chin, medium means chin through shoulder, and long means below the shoulder; length tags describe the loose hair needed before arrangement, without assuming extensions. A style lists every compatible length band, and long also includes waist-length and longer hair. Revivable period styles remain available in contemporary scenes, and hairstyles do not imply descent or restrict presentation. The legacy person.hair_length_texture list remains available during the transition.
